```{r load libraries}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(writexl)
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r load Annotations}
Annotations<-read.delim("C:/Users/kpark/OneDrive/Documents/2021-June_Mote/data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/Kenkel_Genome/P_astreoides_Kenkel2013_totalannotated.txt")
```

```{r T1}
res_In_34_T1 <- read.table(
  "data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/resIn_30_T1vIn_34_T1.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = 1,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "ContigName") %>%
  filter(padj < 0.1) %>%
  select(ContigName, padj, baseMean, log2FoldChange) %>%
  mutate(Direction = case_when(
    log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Downregulated",
    log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Upregulated",
    TRUE ~ "No change")) %>% 
  left_join(Annotations, by = "ContigName")

res_Off_34_T1 <- read.table(
  "data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/resOff_30_T1vOff_34_T1.txt",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  row.names = 1,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE) %>%
  rownames_to_column(var = "ContigName") %>%
  filter(padj < 0.1) %>%
  select(ContigName, padj, baseMean, log2FoldChange) %>%
  mutate(Direction = case_when(
    log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Downregulated",
    log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Upregulated",
    TRUE ~ "No change")) %>% 
  left_join(Annotations, by = "ContigName")

In_only_34_T1 <- res_In_34_T1 %>%
  filter(!ContigName %in% res_Off_34_T1$ContigName) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = "T1") %>%
  mutate(Expressed_in = "Inshore Only")

Off_only_34_T1 <- res_Off_34_T1 %>%
  filter(!ContigName %in% res_In_34_T1$ContigName) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = "T1") %>%
  mutate(Expressed_in = "Offshore Only")

Share_34_T1 <- res_In_34_T1 %>%
  filter(ContigName %in% res_Off_34_T1$ContigName) %>%
  mutate(Timepoint = "T1") %>%
  mutate(Expressed_in = "Both",
         Direction = NA)

DEGs_34_T1_Annotated <- rbind(In_only_34_T1, Off_only_34_T1, Share_34_T1) %>%
  select(ContigName, Timepoint, Expressed_in, padj, Direction, baseMean,
         Description, Keywords, KEGGKO, GO)

write_xlsx(DEGs_34_T1_Annotated, "data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/Annotated_DEGs/DEGs_34_T1_Annotated.xlsx")
```

# Master sheet of target genes
```{r}
all_DEGs_annotated <- rbind(DEGs_34_T1_Annotated,DEGs_34_T2_Annotated, DEGs_34_T3_Annotated, DEGs_34_T4_Annotated, DEGs_34_T5_Annotated)

transcription_factors <- all_DEGs_annotated %>%
  filter(
    grepl("transcription.*factor|factor.*transcription|transcription regulation",
          Description,
          ignore.case = TRUE))

heat_shock <- all_DEGs_annotated %>%
  filter(grepl("heat", Description, ignore.case = TRUE) | 
           grepl("heat", Keywords, ignore.case = TRUE) |
           grepl("hsp", Description, ignore.case = TRUE) | 
           grepl("hsp", Keywords, ignore.case = TRUE))

ubiquitin <- all_DEG_annotated %>%
  filter(grepl("Ubiquitin", Description, ignore.case = TRUE))

apoptosis <- all_DEG_annotated %>%
  filter(grepl("apoptosis", Keywords, ignore.case = TRUE) | 
           grepl("apoptosis", Description, ignore.case = TRUE))

immunity <- all_DEG_annotated %>%
  filter(grepl("immun", Keywords, ignore.case = TRUE) | 
           grepl("immun", Description, ignore.case = TRUE))

```

# Save specific terms excel file 
```{r}
wb <- createWorkbook()

addWorksheet(wb, "all_DEGs_annotated")
writeData(wb, "all_DEGs_annotated",  all_DEGs_annotated)

addWorksheet(wb, "transcription_factors")
writeData(wb, "transcription_factors",  transcription_factors)

addWorksheet(wb, "heat_shock")
writeData(wb, "heat_shock", heat_shock)

addWorksheet(wb, "ubiquitin")
writeData(wb, "ubiquitin", ubiquitin)

addWorksheet(wb, "apoptosis")
writeData(wb, "apoptosis", apoptosis)

addWorksheet(wb, "immunity")
writeData(wb, "immunity", immunity)

saveWorkbook(wb, "data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/Annotated_DEGs/DEG_functional_groups.xlsx", overwrite = TRUE)

```

# Kenkel Genes
```{r find genes function}
find_genes <- function(df, pattern) {
  df %>%
    filter(
      if_any(c(Description, Keywords),
             ~ grepl(pattern, ., ignore.case = TRUE))
)
}
```

```{r gene patterns}
# From Kenkel et al 2011 - Short Term Stress Gene Candidates

gene_patterns_2011 <- list(

  # Ribosomal / control
  rRNA_18s = "18s.*rrna|rrna.*18s",

  Ribosomal_Protein_L11 = "60s.*ribosomal.*l11|ribosomal.*protein.*l11|rpl11",

  NADH_Dehydrogenase = "nadh.*dehydrogenase.*nd5|nd5|nadh.*dehydrogenase",

  Eukaryotic_Initiation_Factor = "eukaryotic.*initiation.*factor.*3.*subunit.*h|eif3h",

  GTP_Binding_Protein = "gtp.*binding.*protein.*gsp2|gsp2",

  # Heat shock / stress
  alpha_b_crystallin = "alpha.*b.*crystallin|crystallin.*alpha.*b|hsp.*16",

  hsp60 = "hsp.*60|heat.*shock.*60",

  hsp90 = "hsp.*90|heat.*shock.*90",

  # Cytoskeleton
  actin_cytoskeleton = "actin.*cytoskeleton|cytoskeletal.*actin",

  # Metabolism
  adk = "adenosine.*kinase|\\badk\\b",

  g3pdh = "glyceraldehyde.*3.*phosphate.*dehydrogenase|g3pdh|gapdh",

  # Immunity
  complement_c3 = "complement.*component.*c3|\\bc3\\b",
  
  c_type_lectin = "c[- ]?type.*lectin|lectin.*c[- ]?type|clect",

  Spondin_2 = "spondin.*2|spon2",

  # Vesicular transport
  Trans_golgi_Network_Protein = "trans.*golgi.*network.*protein|tgoln|golgi.*network",

  # Protein degradation
  Ubiquitin_like_protein_3 = "ubiquitin.*like.*protein.*3|ubl3")


# From Kenkel et al 2013 - Long Term Stress Gene Candidates
gene_patterns_2013 <- list(
  acyl_coa_dehydrogenase = "acyl[- ]?coa.*dehydrogenase|dehydrogenase.*acyl[- ]?coa",
  
  alanine_glyoxylate_aminotransferase =
  "alanine.*glyoxylate.*aminotransferase|alanine.*aminotransferase.*glyoxylate|glyoxylate.*alanine.*aminotransferase",
  
  apolipophorin = "apolipophorin",

  carbonic_anhydrase = "carbonic.*anhydrase",

  collagen_v1_alpha1 = "collagen.*alpha.*1|collagen.*1.*alpha|alpha.*collagen.*1|alpha.*1.*collagen",

  exocyst_complex = "exocyst|exocyst.*component",

  malate_synthase = "malate.*synthase",

  pepck = "phosphoenolpyruvate|pepck|carboxykinase",

  pyruvate_carboxylase = "pyruvate.*carboxylase",

  slc26a6 = "slc26.*6|slc26a6|family.*26.*member.*6")

```


```{r gene list dfs}
# Short Term Stress Gene Candidates
Kenkel_2011_genes <- lapply(names(gene_patterns_2011), function(g) {
  find_genes(all_DEGs_annotated, gene_patterns_2011[[g]]) %>%
    mutate(gene_group = g)
})

Kenkel_2011_genes_df <- bind_rows(Kenkel_2011_genes)

# Long Term Stress Gene Candidates
Kenkel_2013_genes <- lapply(names(gene_patterns_2013), function(g) {
  find_genes(all_DEGs_annotated, gene_patterns_2013[[g]]) %>%
    mutate(gene_group = g)
})

Kenkel_2013_genes_df <- bind_rows(Kenkel_2013_genes)

write_xlsx(Kenkel_2011_genes_df, "data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/Annotated_DEGs/Kenkel_2011_Genes_Short-Term-Stress.xlsx")

write_xlsx(Kenkel_2013_genes_df, "data/Sequencing/Porites_astreoides/DESeq/Annotated_DEGs/Kenkel_2013_Genes_Long-Term-Stress.xlsx")

```
